title: Triangles seen on launch pads at Groom Lake

tellings.quote: I I know numerous people who have have seen triangles on launch pads at at Groom Lake

plain: Triangle-shaped craft have been seen sitting on launch pads at Groom Lake, a secret military test site in the Nevada desert, according to a researcher who goes by UAPGerb. He did not see them himself. He says he knows "numerous people" who have, which, if true, would put such craft on the ground at a US military base.
